about_the_game:
Art of Bloodshed is a stylized medieval arena fighting game that plunges you into brutal, skill-based melee combat. Step into the blood-soaked sands of the arena as a fierce warrior, where each fight is a test of strength, precision, and strategy.

  • Master Ruthless Melee Combat Engage in intense, close-quarters combat with a wide range of brutal attacks. Utilize light and heavy strikes, block incoming blows, dodge with agile rolls, and outmaneuver your opponent with tactical footwork.

  • Dynamic Betting System Not just a fight – it's a spectacle. As a spectator, you can place bets on combatants, using your wits to predict the outcome of each fight. Bet wisely and reap the rewards!

  • Extensive Character Customization Forge your own warrior by customizing your character's appearance. Equip your warrior with a variety of armor sets and weapon skins, making your fighter truly one-of-a-kind.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence, blood effects, and depictions of death in a gladiator arena setting. Players engage in intense melee combat featuring slashing, blunt impacts, and character fatalities. There is no sexual content, drug use, or depictions of self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Art of Bloodshed drops you into a brutal, low-poly medieval arena where every action of yours can mean glory—or defeat. Outsmart your opponent with skill-based melee combat, while spectators place real-time bets on your fate.
